Source contracts: SRE/watch.sh

SRE/watch.sh

Shell · Tier B

Update the deployment-node website checkout and restart its Compose service.

Usage

Run only on the configured deployment node; this watcher has no read-only or help mode.

Inputs

Hard-coded workspace/Compose paths, embedded deployment credentials, origin remote refs and the saved deployed-commit marker.

Side effects

Fetches/prunes remote refs, chooses the newest remote tip, force-resets a local branch, pulls code, stops a matching uvicorn process and restarts Docker Compose through sudo. Probes port 8017 and writes a marker after HTTP 200.

Cleanup

The container remains running and Git state stays changed. A failed probe does not roll back the checkout; this deployment-specific behavior requires separate operational review.

@see scripts/install-website.py
